I farm only 6 mu and there are just two people in my household, so I will keep the year simple and steady. I will put the biggest share into cabbage because I know it well and my usual rotation is cabbage, Chinese cabbage, then cabbage again. I will keep some chili and kidney bean because they spread risk, bring cash at different times, and do not make all my work pile up on the same days. Since I have well irrigation, I will water on time instead of gambling on rain, and because my land is small I will use moderate but reliable fertilizer and a manageable number of pesticide sprays. For the first crop I will plough to set the field well, and later crops I will mostly use rotary tillage to save labor and move faster.
